==Summary==

{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

Egwene is waiting for her formal summons to the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]] while [[Lairain]] instructs her in the formalities. Egwene orders the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] to wait at the [[Sunset Gate]] and prepare to make an apology for rebelling against the [[The White Tower|White Tower]]. Egwene enters the Hall where eleven Sitters await. Those missing are either on Tower business or are [[Black Ajah]] that fled. Egwene sees that no Red Sitter is in attendance and orders that [[Silviana]] be brought from her cell to the Hall immediately. The ceremony commences and Egwene is again raised [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]], with [[Saerin Asnobar]] placing the [[Stole of the Amyrlin Seat|stole]] over Egwene's shoulders.

Silviana arrives and approaches Egwene and kneels. Some of the Sitters object to Egwene dispensing justice at this time. She berates all of them for the injustice done to Silviana, the dissension among the Ajahs, the original decision to depose Siuan and raise [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]] and their inaction as Elaida made one poor decision after another. She then requests Silviana be her [[Keeper of the Chronicles|Keeper]], partially to show that the [[Red Ajah]] is not being left out of events. Silviana accepts, saying she would be honored to serve. After a few encouraging words to the Sitters, they leave the Hall to meet up with the Rebel Aes Sedai. Silviana then asks about her current Keeper with the Rebel Aes Sedai but Egwene tells her she was Black and executed. 

Egwene addresses both groups of Aes Sedai, shaming them for their actions but encouraging them to begin anew to make a re-forged White Tower.
